html:
Given 1 <= n <= 9, return a (2*n-1)-by-(2*n-1) square. Outer cells contain n, the next ring n-1, and the center 1. Separate values by one space; no leading or trailing spaces.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    3
  ],
  "expected": [
    "3 3 3 3 3",
    "3 2 2 2 3",
    "3 2 1 2 3",
    "3 2 2 2 3",
    "3 3 3 3 3"
  ]
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    1
  ],
  "expected": [
    "1"
  ]
}
Hint

A cell's ring is its minimum distance to any border.

Complexity: O(n^2) characters of time and output
